turns.content: For rho=(1/2)(|0><0|+|1><1|), write the two computational-basis projectors as 2x2 matrices.
Add them and simplify rho, stating all four matrix entries.
Compare the result with rho=(1/2)(I+r dot sigma) to determine the Bloch vector r.
Locate the state in the Bloch ball and interpret the norm of r in terms of purity.
Using the Bloch vector just obtained, reconstruct rho and check that current representation internally.
Check the result independently from the eigenvalues and Tr(rho^2).
Report the Bloch vector and geometric location.
